Watube is released under the GPL-3.0 license. This app also bundles the following open-source libraries. Tap an entry to read its license.

These features are specific to Watube and are not part of the upstream code base:

• Privacy hub: a single screen that groups every anti-fingerprinting switch
• Hardening enabled by default (privacy is opt-out, not opt-in)
• Automatic rotation of the SponsorBlock id (12h / 24h / manual)
• Neutral region: trending is requested for the United Kingdom, the same country for every user
• One generic User-Agent for every request: API, thumbnails, downloads and third party services
• No SIM or carrier based country leak
• WebView hardening: no DOM cache, no third party cookies
• One tap reset of identifiers (SponsorBlock id, WebView data)
• Release builds only trust system certificates, user installed CAs are debug only
• Local Return YouTube Dislike counter

Everything you need to get the most out of Watube — a private, account-free way to watch.
No. Watube works entirely without any account or sign-in. Your subscriptions, history and playlists stay on your device.
In full local mode the app fetches everything directly, without going through any third-party server. It is the most private way to use Watube.
How do I download a video?
Open a video, then tap Download in the action row under the player. Downloads are available offline from the Library tab.
SponsorBlock automatically skips sponsored segments, intros and other interruptions, using a community database. You can configure it in Settings.
How does Watube protect my privacy?
Watube sends no personal identifiers, rotates anonymous identifiers, can request a neutral region, and hardens its embedded WebView. See Settings → Privacy.
Can I back up my data?
Yes. Settings → Data & maintenance → Backup lets you export and restore your subscriptions, playlists and history.

When the Trends region is set to Automatic, trending is requested for a neutral country instead of your device country: the United Kingdom, shared by every user, or the country picked with the "Manual only" rotation. No Watube request then tells your country. Your IP address stays visible to the server (YouTube in local mode, the Piped instance otherwise): only a VPN hides it. Changes the trending videos shown.
